Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly concluded that there were no studio albums released by Mercedes Sosa between 2000 and 2009, despite not fully extracting and analyzing the complete list of albums from the "Studio albums" subsection. This premature conclusion led to the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
